# Omnitryx Inc.

> Omnitryx Inc. is a federally incorporated Canadian company building multiple businesses to create jobs, serve people, and make communities economically stronger. Founded and led by Jawwad Abbasi, based in Ontario, Canada.

## About Omnitryx

Omnitryx Inc. is a multi-business company operating across technology and publishing, with more ventures in development. The company is built on the belief that business, done right, is one of the most powerful ways to improve the world. Each division is designed to create meaningful employment, serve people honestly, and contribute to stronger communities.

Corporation Number: 1753311-0. Incorporated federally in Canada, operating out of Ontario.

## Founder

Jawwad Abbasi is the Founder and Chief Executive of Omnitryx Inc. He is a Canadian software engineer, entrepreneur, and published author based in Ontario.

He spent five years as a Senior Software Developer at CGI, one of Canada's largest technology companies, building enterprise cloud systems and shipping production software used by major clients. He has also built and shipped production mobile applications used by thousands of people worldwide.

He founded Omnitryx Inc. to build businesses that employ people, solve real problems, and create opportunity for those who need it. He is also the author of The Power of Tahajjud and is on a mission to get 2 billion Muslims to pray Tahajjud.

- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jaabbasi/

## Divisions

### Technology Division

The Omnitryx Technology Division builds and deploys production-grade software for businesses that require institutional-level execution. Services include:

- Web and application development
- iOS and Android mobile app development
- API architecture and system integration
- AI systems and intelligent automation
- Cloud infrastructure on AWS
- App Store publishing and deployment
- Enterprise technology consulting
- Microsoft 365 and business productivity setup

To work with the Technology Division: jawwad@omnitryx.ca or https://calendly.com/jawwad_ab/30min

### Publishing Division

The Omnitryx Publishing Division produces books authored by Jawwad Abbasi, published through Amazon KDP and available worldwide.

Current title: The Power of Tahajjud: Real Stories of Success and Miracles

The book collects real stories of Muslims who prayed Tahajjud during their hardest moments and witnessed extraordinary results. Themes include career struggle, financial hardship, marriage, loss, addiction, and reconnecting with Allah. It has reached readers across the United Kingdom, United States, Canada, India, and Pakistan.

More titles are in development across Islamic subjects, entrepreneurship, and technology.

- Book website: https://poweroftahajjud.com
- Amazon US: https://www.amazon.com/dp/1067506608
